entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Draco-villain planeswalker with millennia of schemes who has set his sights on control of the entire Multiverse.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The vast struggle of many planeswalkers and beings across times and worlds, which Bolas seeks to control.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane of shards whose Bant, Jund and Naya shards lent heroes to oppose Bolas.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara; Elspeth claimed it as her adopted homeland.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara whose apex predators are dragons and whose warrior-chief is Kresh.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara, home of Ajani.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara firmly under the sway of Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara obsessed with its dwindling etherium, which ignored Bolas's influence until too late.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Errant knight who claimed Bant as her adopted homeland; central figure of the Bant hero deck. A planeswalker.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker from Naya whose quest to discover his brother's killer led him to face Bolas.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker and dragon-worshipper, Jund's planeswalker-in-residence, who ultimately sided with Bolas.

entities.name: Kresh
entities.description: Jund warrior-chief who leads the Jund hero deck in place of a planeswalker.

events.summary: Ajani's quest to discover his brother's killer leads him to a face-to-face conflict with Bolas.
events.quote: Ajani's quest to discover his brother's killer led to a face-to-face conflict with Mr. Bolas himself

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol ultimately sides with Bolas, leaving Jund without a planeswalker hero.
events.quote: ultimately, Sarkhan sided with the mighty dragon.
the dragon-worshipper having succumbed to Bolas's rule.

events.summary: Grixis falls under Bolas's sway while Esper ignores his influence until too late.
events.quote: Grixis was firmly under the sway of Nicol Bolas
